items.name: Eleanor M.
items.text: The most beautiful sky I have ever seen. Our guide knew every dune by name and the camp was genuinely luxurious. We didn't want to leave.

items.name: Thomas & Léa
items.text: We did the Grand Crossing and it felt like stepping off the edge of the world. Five days of absolute silence and gold.

items.name: Yuki T.
items.text: As a solo traveler I was nervous, but the team made me feel completely safe and included. The stargazing night was unforgettable.

items.name: The Alvarez Family
items.text: Our kids still talk about the camel ride and the bread baked in the sand. A real adventure, but so well organized.

items.name: David R.
items.text: From Marrakech to the dunes and back, every transfer was seamless. Aït Ben Haddou at sunset was a highlight of our whole trip to Morocco.
